full_judgment: "198. Notice of proceedings-No proceeding other than a suit shall be commenced against any person for anything purporting to be done in pursuance of the Act without giving to such person a month's previous notice in writing of the intended proceeding and of the cause there-of; or limitation-After the expiration of three months from the accrual of such cause."
